integrity: Each classified map is justified by explicit pairwise interpolation with genuine derivations or automorphisms. All cardinalities follow from finite projective-line and homogeneous-function enumeration. The supplied script checks finite cases but is not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The main result is an all-finite-field theorem; only q=2 exhaustive and q=3 sampled finite computations were carried out. No claim of exhaustive publication priority or of independent validation is made. Earlier existence results and studies limited to linear maps are credited.
title: Complete two-local symmetry census of the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra over finite fields
